text:
Hannah (SE): quick thread for BlueLake POC. They want streaming chat with server-side tool calls into their ERP, strict JSON schema enforcement, and examples in Node + Rust. Core asks: ephemeral creds, token rotation cadence, hosted vs reserved delta, and SOC2/KMS wording for procurement.
Diego (AE): customer expects ~200 rps peak but only 8h/day for pilot. They asked if streaming has a surcharge and whether reserved is necessary for p95 <250ms.
Priyanka (Eng): streaming is per-token billing; no separate streaming surcharge. For 200 rps @ ~140 tokens we recommend reserved Dedicated for stable p95 <250ms — hosted pilot OK but tails possible. Need exact pilot hours to quote.
Hannah (SE): pilot hours = 8h/day, 3 weeks. They also require tool callbacks to talk to internal ERP via webhook or queue; prefer queue for durability.
Omar (Security): webhook guidance: prefer push to customer-owned queue (SQS/Kafka). If direct webhooks needed: mTLS + IP allowlist + rotating short-lived webhook tokens. KMS: Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Dedicated can include EKM addendum. Hosted uses Redwood KMS. We'll add standard SOC2 language.
Priyanka (Eng): runbook (short): 1) onboard as hosted for day-0 tests; 2) provision 1-node Dedicated if they want latency SLOs; 3) enable structured_output_mode with strict_schema=true and action=reject; 4) set up credential-broker for STS tokens; 5) route toolcall results through customer queue if requested.
Hannah (SE): can you drop Node + Rust SDK snippets for streaming + token provider?
Priyanka (Eng): Node snippet (very short):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ tokenProvider });
for await (const ev of client.chatStream({ model: 'redwood-4', streaming: true })) { if (ev.type==='toolcall') handleTool(ev.payload); else processDelta(ev.delta); }
```
Rust snippet (compact):
```rust
let client = redwood::Client::with_token_provider(MyProvider::new());
let mut s = client.chat_stream("redwood-4", msgs).await?;
while let Some(ev) = s.next().await { match ev { Event::ToolCall(r) => handle_tool(r).await?, Event::Delta(d) => print!("{}", d.text), _ => {} } }
```
Diego (AE): pricing ask: two scenarios please — hosted per-token estimate for 8h/day pilot (3 weeks) and a reserved 1-node monthly commit quote (pro-rate ok). Need ballpark by EOD.
Priyanka (Eng): quick back-of-envelope: 200 rps * 140 tokens * 8h/day * 21 days = ~4.0 billion tokens. Hosted @ $X per 1M -> estimate A. Reserved: 1-node monthly = $Y + lower unit. I'll produce two line-item scenarios with totals.
Omar (Security): I'll paste SOC2 boilerplate and KMS wording; note: for callbacks require mTLS + allowlist + recommend queue.
Hannah (SE): schema enforcement: customer wants fail-fast on invalid JSON and notification webhook to their telemetry pipeline. Can we do that?
Priyanka (Eng): yes: strict_schema=true with action=reject will return 422 and emit a schema_violation event we can POST to their telemetry endpoint or enqueue to their queue. Also support auto-fallback to a conservative model variant after N violations.
InfraBot: provisioning runbook and sample STS broker are at https://internal.redwood/poctemplates/bluelake (includes Terraform + lambda examples).
Diego (AE): blockers before kickoff: 1) EKM wording for legal, 2) sample credential-broker and terraform, 3) hosted vs reserved numbers.
Hannah (SE): next steps: 1) Diego to confirm pilot hours (done), 2) Priyanka to post quoted numbers + brief runbook by EOD, 3) Omar to add SOC2/KMS + webhook hardening text, 4) schedule 30m tech kickoff next Wed.
Priyanka (Eng): will post numbers and a compact checklist within 3 hours.
Omar (Security): will drop security wording in the questionnaire doc.
Hannah (SE): thanks all :thumbsup: tagging @Priyanka @Omar @Diego for deliverables.
